CustomField.description: How many times ExtractAddressQueueable has died with an unhandled exception while routing this row (Status__c = 'Failed'). Written only by RoutingFailureFinalizer; read only by RoutingRetrySweepBatch to enforce the retry attempt cap. Zero on a row that has never failed.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Incremented by the routing Finalizer on each unhandled-exception death. The retry sweeper abandons a row once this reaches the attempt cap.
CustomField.label: Routing Attempt Count
